title: Headless ED-E My Love (vDialogueEDE), the Followers path: ED-E repaired in Primm and hired, its two logs, the radio call, April Martimer's upgrade at the Followers, ED-E back and the quest completed

actions.text: Path: the broken eyebot in Primm is repaired by its message boxes (Repair, VNPCFollowers bEDEAvailable) and hired (bEDEHired, Enhanced Sensors on the player); asking about it (here Old Lady Gibson's greeting) sets vDialogueEDE 10 once five days have passed since the last log, and ED-E's dialogue package plays its first log (iLogsPlayed 1), the second time its second (iLogsPlayed 2, stage 20); two days later ED-E picks up a radio call (iEDERadio); April Martimer of the Followers upgrades ED-E (iFolUpgrade, objective 35); three days later the upgraded ED-E is back by the Lucky 38's marker and its package ends the quest (iEDEOut 5, CompleteQuest). Outcome taken: the Followers' upgrade. Others: the Brotherhood's upgrade at Hidden Valley (iHVUpgrade, objective 25), or the quest failed (100) when both April and the Brotherhood's knight are dead. ED-E My Love has no completing stage (10 and 20 only, 100 fails): CompleteQuest marks it done. Its reward is ED-E's upgraded armor or weapons; ED-E's companion perk is Enhanced Sensors (on hiring).
Stand-in for the walk into Johnson Nash's house in Primm.

ED-E has no sayable greeting (its one GREETING line has contradictory conditions), and our engine starts no conversation with an actor that has no line to say, so the player cannot talk to it to hire it (a stall, see the report). Stand-in: its hire line (FollowersHired, the RobotEDE voice) said.
Stand-in for five days passing (the game clock set forward).

ED-E's dialogue package (EDEDialoguePackage02, topic EDELog1) starts no conversation headless, and its log lines name another speaker (VHDMikeLawson, the recorded voice) with no GetIsID condition, which our rule lets only that speaker say (a stall, see the report). Stand-in: the log line said by ED-E.
Stand-in for asking someone else about ED-E (some 40 lines across the Mojave set the stage again; Old Lady Gibson's greeting is said once).
Stand-in for ED-E's radio package: the Brotherhood knight's call (a line with another fixed speaker, as the logs) said by ED-E.
Stand-in for the trip to the signal's source: its trigger, then the Brotherhood's mission holotape picked up.
Stand-in for finding Hidden Valley on the map.
Stand-in for ED-E's radio package: April Martimer's call said by ED-E.
Stand-in for three days passing; a menu opened (the Pip-Boy) lets the quest's MenuMode block move the upgraded ED-E to its marker.
Stand-in for the upgraded ED-E's dialogue package (EDEQuestCompleteDialogue) reaching the player.
